candidate: J: adaptive L at 120 seconds, 512 output tokens, no outer model retries
public_trace_findings: Two episodes explicitly reported OutputTokenLimitExceeded before any public response; 512 tokens is insufficient for these thinking/code decisions.
Three episodes timed out in the model and now stopped quickly because identical outer retries were disabled.
The album task again produced an incorrect confident completion without authenticated proof of its play_music effect.

decision: Reject the 512-token/120-second configuration. Restore 1024 tokens and 180 seconds for S2 while retaining no-identical-retry and the authenticated-action/write-verification fixes. Do not describe early controlled failures as an efficiency improvement.
